identification: Large rustic two-door primitive cupboard, vertical board construction, worn original red paint, cast iron T-strap hinges, four open shelves; 169x137x66 cm; borer, loose top batten, paint loss and staining. Not a named maker or high-end piece; decorative farmhouse category.

entries.note: Painted kauri pine 2 door cupboard with adjustable shelving; neater, likely smaller piece. Paid locally: what we might pay, not a resale price. Local database hit.
